evidence.art: The painted title (002_title), film stills 005-018 and environment plates (031, 046) are rich, warm and cohesive. The 3D walkers (020, 028, 039) look flat and cartoon-like next to them.
evidence.continuity: Bald Ankhu, white kilt and brown sandals hold across 005, 006, 008, 012, 028 and 045. Film Anpu (014-017) has a gold-banded kilt, a barely visible ankh and sceptre, and a bare leopard-less torso. Walk Anpu (020, 047) is a black silhouette with black legs, a tiny blue nemes and an unreadable ankh. Film attendants are glossy and sculpted; walk attendants are matte and low-detail.
evidence.cinematography_cuts: Film shots are strong and varied: 006 close-up, 009 split-frame, 010 funeral procession, 018 wide to a high-angle push (019). Walk cuts at 021, 024, 030, 037 and 040 are motivated, and the gate framing in 040-049 is excellent. The 011 dissolve is muddy, and 020/021 crops Anpu's head and body.
evidence.motion_fx: Walk poses vary little, with repeated stiff striding (025, 031, 033). Anpu stays near-static from 042 to 049 and the attendants slide. There is no visible dust. 035 and 036 show the group as tiny, stuttering figures. Shadow flicker is minor.
evidence.character_grounding: Cast shadows are present (020, 028), and feet look planted in 030 and 040. Characters are tiny and poorly lit against the plates (026-029). Anpu is clipped by the brazier in 029/032. In 038 Ankhu hides behind Anpu. Black leg and torso silhouettes lose volume, and 044-048 give them a pasted-on look.
evidence.game_feel: The camera handover is clean and the destination (pylon, then gate) is always readable from lit braziers and sphinxes. Pace is slow and the group sometimes nearly leaves frame (029, 035). Where to go is unclear in the 037-039 high angle.
evidence.ui_title: 002_title has a clear hierarchy: a gold serif logo, a highlighted BEGIN JOURNEY and legible menu type. Subtitles (026, 028, 047) are legible. The end card in 049 is good, and the fade in 004/050 is smooth. The menu text is small.
evidence.audio_dialogue: Judged from subtitles and timing only: the lines are well written and paced (I served your house..., I know. I was there..., Walk with me, Ankhu...), and the subtitles change at sensible beats. I cannot verify the voice audio.

defects.what: 3D walk Anpu and attendants are flat black silhouettes that do not match the painted film versions: black legs, unreadable ankh and sceptre, no leopard-skin detail, and a tiny nemes.
Characters are tiny and under-lit against the plates. Anpu is clipped by a brazier, Ankhu is occluded behind Anpu in the high-angle shot, and there is no contact shadow or dust.
Stiff, repeating stride poses, sliding feet and a near-static Anpu at the gate. No dust or ambient motion.
